answer: When the warp is ready, the comber reeds the warp through the reed with the reed hook, wetting the reed hook so it slides smooth. Distaff madder cloth finisher woad seal watches the reeding: a seal madder cloth finishers renew after finishing shed hearings. The thread marks the reeding, the glacier marks the reed, the karst marks the warp. A forger would fake 41 false reeds and 41 false reedings.
